purpose: Say that an event occurs only rarely.
keywords: I rarely eat out on weekdays.
It rarely snows in this town.
restrictions: Allows occasional exceptions; less absolute than 決して〜ない.
mistake: Keep the negative form: めったに行かない.

segments.role: Say that an event occurs only rarely. めったに + negative predicate
Say that an event occurs only rarely. めったに + negative predicate
